claim: For every nonempty finite set D of distinct integers at least 4, write sigma(D)=sum_{d in D}1/(d-1) and H={h in D:sigma(D minus {h})>=1}; if H is nonempty with gcd(H)=1, then for every integer k>=1 and finite set F of labels (d,j) with d in D and j>=k, there is an explicitly recursive infinite sequence Q of distinct remaining labels, strictly increasing in numerical value q_i, whose complement R has finite subset sums with all consecutive gaps at most g=ceil(sum_{d in D}d^k/(d-1)+sum_{(d,j) in F}d^j), such that every h in H occurs infinitely often in Q with bounded gaps between its selected exponents and sum_i ||beta q_i||^2=infinity for every beta in R/Z other than zero; moreover for every integer L>=1 the finite subset sums of all remaining labels contain L consecutive integers, with a terminating witness procedure and each label used at most once.

shape.objects: The explicit least-power cyclic recursion constructs the infinite selected label sequence Q and its complement R. The analytical candidate proves common extension of all finite selected prefixes with a fixed gap and positive buffer, and bounded exponent gaps for every active base. Individual interval witnesses have finite labelled supports. Exact integer and set objects have Lean analogues, but the full FS-mean library inventory remains unaudited.
shape.quantifiers: For every such finite D with removable core H of gcd one, every positive cutoff k and every finite labelled deletion F, construct Q and R with a fixed explicitly stated gap bound and bounded exponent gaps for each h, prove divergence for every nontrivial character, and for every positive L obtain a finite legal interval witness; distinct occurrence labels are retained even when values coincide. The leading quantifiers are universal over arithmetic inputs; existence is over sequences and finite interval witnesses, not a universality claim about all sets of reals.
shape.target_quantity: Existence and construction of the exact partition with specified g, spectral divergence and all finite interval witnesses, not an extremal constant or an upper density bound. An unspecified complement gap does not meet the specified g. Interval location and termination time may be nonuniform; no complexity bound is requested.
shape.ambient_structure: Integer order, labelled once-only capacities, base arithmetic and characters coexist. The ambient supplies least-power recursion and concatenation of compatible finite labelled prefixes; the preservation invariant is still to prove. The published FS-mean sumset theorem applies on Z once its hypotheses hold. No pairwise-overlap/spread estimate, closed density-increment family, or property-reflecting categorical transport is supplied.
shape.symmetries: Reordering D or H cyclically does not change the hypothesis. Distinct labels with equal numerical values remain independent. Union of disjoint supports preserves legal sums; arbitrary translation, dilation, intersection or base restriction need not preserve the exact labelled structure or removable-core criterion.
shape.configuration: The preserved relation is a disjoint Q,R partition of every undeleted label, a fixed upper bound g on consecutive gaps of FS_0(R), bounded exponent gaps for each active base, and once-only representation of intervals. FS_0 includes the empty sum. These are positive representation and chain constraints, not configuration avoidance. Arbitrary restriction of bases can destroy H or its gcd; arbitrary truncation of a candidate finite interval destroys that witness and an arbitrary selected subsequence can lose spectral recurrence.
shape.finite_certificates: A single proposed recursion step, its least-power seed and each finite interval witness can be checked by exact arithmetic. The smallest nonempty seed has one selected power with positive proposed buffer, to be justified analytically. Such local certificates do not certify either side of the full infinite Q,R partition claim. No finite reduction, computation contract, producer or globally bounded seed search is admitted.
shape.monotonicity: For the interval assertion shorter L and more available labels are weaker requirements; L starts at one. The exact specified-g partition claim is not a scalar critical-threshold problem. No finite maximum on D,k,F or L is available.
shape.uniformity_parameter: All D,k,F and all characters and interval lengths are retained. The gap g may depend on D,k,F but must be fixed before the infinite extraction, and each active base needs an exponent-gap bound independent of the number of selected labels. No uniform witness height over all inputs is requested.
